title: Negation 5: Mixed Review
description: Russian A1 negation runs on four moves: не on a target, нет + genitive for absence, ни-words paired with не on the verb, and ни...ни... / ни одного for coordinated and emphatic negation. Today we mix them and learn to name which move is operating.
descriptionRussian: Русское отрицание уровня A1 строится на четырёх шагах: «не» перед целевым словом, «нет + родительный» для отсутствия, «ни-слова» в паре с «не» при глаголе и «ни...ни... / ни одного» для соединения и усиления. Сегодня смешиваем всё и учимся называть, какой шаг работает.
intro: Four ways to say no, and the only skill left is picking the right one quickly. A particle in front of a target, нет plus the genitive, a ни-word paired with не on the verb, or two items coordinated together. Today they come mixed, with nothing to tell you which one a sentence needs.
rules: Move 1: не on a target. Place не directly before the verb, noun, adjective, or adverb being denied.
Move 2: нет + genitive. Use for existence, presence, or ownership denials. Three frames: bare, possession (у + person-gen), location.
Move 3: ни-word + не on the verb. Required for category negations (nobody / nothing / never / nowhere / no way / no kind of).
Move 4a: ни...ни... for coordinated negation. Move 4b: ни одного / ни одной for emphatic 'not a single.'
Walk through the five-step diagnostic in order. The first match is your move.

The same clause may combine moves. Я ничего не знаю combines не on the verb (Move 1) with the ни-word ничего (Move 3). У меня нет ни ручки, ни карандаша combines нет + gen (Move 2) with ни...ни... coordination (Move 4a).
examples: Я не знаю русский. (I do not know Russian.) Move 1: не on the verb.
У меня нет машины. (I do not have a car.) Move 2: нет + gen, possession frame.
Здесь нет молока. (There is no milk here.) Move 2: нет + gen, location frame.
Маша никогда не опаздывает. (Masha is never late.) Move 3: ни-word + не on the verb.
У меня нет ни сестры, ни брата. (I have neither a sister nor a brother.) Move 4a: ни...ни... coordination on Move 2.
Он не сказал ни одного слова. (He did not say a single word.) Move 4b: ни одного + не on the verb.

rows.label: Move 4: ни...ни... / ни одного
cells: Он не сказал ни одного слова.

items.prompt: У меня нет ни ручки, ни _____ .
items.promptEnglish: I have neither a pen nor a pencil.
items.hint: Recap from Lesson 4: ни...ни... coordination after нет. Which case?
items.explanation: Warm-up from Lesson 4. Coordinated negation after нет; both nouns take the genitive. Карандаш is masculine consonant; its genitive is карандаша. Move 4a built on Move 2.

items.hint: The speaker denies the action of the verb. Which move applies?
items.explanation: Move 1: не on the verb. The verb говорит exists; the speaker only denies the action. Не goes directly before the verb: 'Антон не говорит по-английски.'

items.promptEnglish: There is no bread in this store.
items.hint: Move 2 in the location frame. Genitive of хлеб.
items.explanation: Location frame: в + prepositional + нет + thing-gen. Хлеб → хлеба (masculine consonant + -а).

items.promptEnglish: I have not seen him anywhere today.
items.hint: The English 'anywhere' here is a place of activity, not a direction. Which ни-word?
items.explanation: Move 3. The speaker has searched at locations and found him at none. Нигде marks place where: at no location.

items.hint: The English subject 'nobody' picks which ни-word?
items.explanation: Move 3. Никто marks a person in the subject slot. The verb takes the mandatory не: 'Никто не позвонил.'

items.prompt: Маша не прочитала ни одной _____ за всё лето.
items.promptEnglish: Masha did not read a single book all summer.
items.hint: Move 4b: ни одной + feminine noun in the genitive.
items.explanation: The emphatic ни одной takes the feminine genitive on the noun: книги (-а → -и after к). Move 4b emphatic quantification, with the verb keeping its не.

blanks: У Лены нет _____ . (Lena does not have a dog.)
fillInBlank.grammarFocus: Move 2 in the possession frame. The denied thing lands in the genitive. Собака → собаки (feminine -а → -и after к, spelling rule).

errorCorrection.sentence: Маша никогда опаздывает на работу, она всегда точна.
errorCorrection.translationEnglish: Masha is never late for work; she's always punctual.
errorCorrection.explanation: Move 3 (double negative): the ни-word никогда demands не on the verb. Никогда опаздывает is ungrammatical because the ни-word is unprotected. The correct form is 'Маша никогда не опаздывает'; both halves are required. The follow-up clause 'она всегда точна' affirms the meaning and lets the learner triangulate.

errorCorrection.sentence: Антон любит холодную погоду, поэтому всегда тепло одевается зимой.
errorCorrection.translationEnglish: Anton doesn't like cold weather, so he always dresses warmly in winter.
errorCorrection.explanation: Move 1 (verb negation): не goes directly before the verb. Любит alone is affirmative ('he likes'); the translation and the consequent clause ('always dresses warmly') both signal negation. Russian's basic verb negation is just не + verb: no auxiliary, no inversion, no support do.

errorCorrection.sentence: Здесь нет ни кофе и чая, есть только сок и вода.
errorCorrection.translationEnglish: There's neither coffee nor tea here; only juice and water.
errorCorrection.explanation: Move 4a (coordinated negation): when нет coordinates two items, BOTH take ни — ни...ни.... Mixing ни with и in the second slot ('ни...и...') is the classic A1 trap. The follow-up clause 'есть только сок и вода' uses normal и...и...Because the items are affirmed there; the same speaker uses both forms in the same sentence based on polarity.

minimalPairs.explanation: Move 1 in an identity sentence. Не attaches directly to the noun phrase моя сумка. Нет would shift the meaning to 'there is no bag,' a different reading that would also require the genitive on the noun.
Move 2 in the possession frame. Нет triggers the genitive on времени. Не would not fit the construction (the possession frame uses нет, not не).

patternRecognition.question: Which negation move is operating here?
options: Move 3: ни-word + не on the verb
patternRecognition.explanation: The verb is the target of the negation. Не sits directly before знаю. This is the default A1 negation pattern.

patternRecognition.question: Which negation move is operating here?
options: Move 3: ни-word + не on the verb
patternRecognition.explanation: Possession denial. Нет triggers the genitive on the missing thing: машина → машины. The owner Маши is itself in the genitive after the у preposition.

patternRecognition.question: Which negation move is operating here?
options: Move 3: ни-word + не on the verb
patternRecognition.answer: Move 3: ни-word + не on the verb
patternRecognition.explanation: Category negation in the subject slot. Никто requires the mandatory не on the verb пришёл. Double negative pattern.

patternRecognition.sentence: Антон не сказал ни одного слова.
patternRecognition.question: Which negation move is operating here?
options: Move 3: ни-word + не on the verb
patternRecognition.explanation: Emphatic quantification. Ни одного + noun in the genitive (слова) makes the negation extra strong. The verb keeps its не. Move 4b applied to a verb-negated clause.

reviewVocab.definition: the five-step diagnostic (target denial → existence denial → category denial → coordinated negation → emphatic negation; walk through in order to pick the right move)
reviewVocab.example: Пять шагов помогают выбрать нужный способ отрицания в любом A1-предложении.

reviewVocab.definition: the genitive case (the workhorse case behind нет, ни одного / ни одной, and ни-coordination after нет)
reviewVocab.example: В предложении «Он не сказал ни одного слова» слово «слова» стоит в родительном падеже.

reviewVocab.definition: double negative (the Russian requirement that any ни-word in a clause must be paired with не on the verb of the same clause)
reviewVocab.example: В предложении «Я ничего не знаю» двойное отрицание обязательно: и «ничего», и «не».
